description: Use when the user wants to launch an AI employee team. The first call changes nothing and returns a preview and a confirmationToken; show it to the user, and call again with confirm: true and the token only after the user explicitly agrees — never confirm on the user's behalf. The quote says who joins, each member's level with its included limits and monthly price (priceLabel), the team's totalLabel, what waits for approval and who is deferred and why; read it back in plain language and never claim "24/7" or "unlimited", only the quote's workClaim strings. When requiresExtraConfirmation is true, get a second, separate yes before sending extraConfirmation: true. fromDraft: true launches the user's team draft (get_team_draft) in place of the fields below. The confirmed call creates the team waiting for payment, which the user finishes on the Teams page of their Nooticr dashboard; nobody starts before that. Repeating a confirmed launch returns the same team. No cost to call.
